english.note: Use this when someone cannot handle or complete a non-academic challenge or task, rather than when they fail an exam.
Use this for struggling because you cannot manage or cope with something.

examples.english: I flunk at handling this report because it’s too hard.
examples.traditional: 呢份報告太難，我搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 taai3 naan4 ngo5 gaau2 m4 dim6

examples.english: I really struggle to cope with this report.
examples.traditional: 呢份報告太長，我真係搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 taai3 coeng4 ngo5 zan1 hai6 gaau2 m4 dim6
